name: TreeShadeAdvisor
description: TreeShadeAdvisor is a web-based tool for designing tree layouts and simulating how tree shade changes across a site over time. Users can test spacing, orientation, planting patterns and tree dimensions, inspect results in 2D and 3D, and analyze quantitative shade outputs. It is intended for agroforestry, silvopasture, alley cropping, coffee/cocoa systems, forestry and other tree-based planning contexts.
access_procedure: Create a free account at https://treeshadeadvisor.com/app/signup or write to support@treeshadeadvisor.com for institutional access.
feedback_tool_info: Web-based agroforestry shade simulation. Local simulations can run in the browser; Cloud API use is optional and uses credits. Public contact: support@treeshadeadvisor.com
indicators_other: Tree shade (hourly shade simulation, 2D/3D shade maps and quantitative shade outputs)
input_data_formats_other: API and interactive web form: users enter plot geometry, tree placement, spacing, dimensions, location and simulation period in the application UI
